title: Concept: Content-Security-Policy frame-src allows every origin
description: The policy allowed any origin to be framed. A framed document is still the attacker's code, drawn inside a page the user trusts; it can imitate the interface, request permissions in context, and redirect the top-level document when the frame is allowed to navigate. The finding is the unbounded frame origin list.
applicability: HTML responses that carry a Content-Security-Policy.
risk: In-page phishing and forced navigation through embedded content; MEDIUM severity.
